title: REPORT on the implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market
part_text: 4. Underlines that regulatory streamlining and simplification are aimed at facilitating compliance processes, while upholding the EU’s core policy objectives, ensuring that social standards, as well as digital rights and consumer protection, are not compromised, and ensuring a stable and predictable regulatory environment for businesses that provides legal clarity and certainty for all; underlines that competitiveness and innovation, especially in the context of the current cost-of-living crisis, must deliver outcomes that benefit consumers; stresses that simplification should also reinforce the EU’s long-term objectives, including the digitalisation of the economy and consumer protection, while ensuring technology neutrality;
